preparation: Export clean pinned source; use the committed font and existing prepare_layout.py exactly once with language=en. One shared prepared reference; Chinese styles are selected at render time, not by preparing it again.
package: Official TDK verify -> package -> existing deterministic ZIP canonicalization -> official unpackage -> verify. PO is a separate translation input, not automatically loaded from the template ZIP.
metadata_compatibility_fix: Restore root-zh-hant >=2.7.0 eligibility already supported by the frozen Chinese DT. Original root/lifesciences eligibility and all format UUIDs/steps remain unchanged.
native_evidence_reuse: All 77 packaged src files, including layout, fonts and prepared reference.docx, are byte-identical to the previously native-verified PO package. Reuse its 56 page-pair comparison/visual evidence only with this exact Worker and catalog. No new PDF/DOCX documents generated in this packaging check.

loader_states: Same updatedAt cache hit without download
local_worker_checks.s3: Local stub implementing the download contract only; real S3/database/network not exercised.
local_worker_checks.output_storage: Hashes only for matching HTML; no duplicated large HTML or new native output documents.

publication_guard: Experimental 0.3.78 coordinates are not authorized for upload or overwriting any existing release. Assign a new immutable release identity and rebind acceptance before publication.
official_locale_boundary: Stock Worker reads MO (or compiles PO fallback), selecting by locale UUID and invalidating cache by updatedAt. Its loader does not validate the source template commit/hash. A separate paired release receipt is still required. Server locale DTO/UI/source binding has not been established by this experiment.

locale_contract_for_server_maintainers_t.translation_update: A changed catalog must update locale.updatedAt so Worker invalidates its cached MO. Do not reuse an unchanged stamp for new bytes.
locale_contract_for_server_maintainers_t.source_pairing: Bind the installed locale to the approved template/PO/MO pair outside the Worker loader; the local experiment does not establish how the Server API enforces or stores this association.
locale_contract_for_server_maintainers_t.user_selection: Confirm how users select the official locale and how template/format names appear. Do not assume the old separate Chinese DT or current Tool render-project request selects it automatically.

proposed_authority_after_cutover_not_app.english_repository: Shared marked Jinja, KM mappings, complete English message units, generated POT and locale-aware layout/Word helpers.
proposed_authority_after_cutover_not_app.chinese_repository: The single human-editable zh-Hant PO, pinned English source commit, translation version and paired acceptance/release manifest.
proposed_authority_after_cutover_not_app.legacy_translation_tree: Retain in history/read-only archive after approved cutover; do not maintain Markdown translations and PO as two live editable authorities.
proposed_authority_after_cutover_not_app.current_migration_PO: English experimental branch copy only. Do not begin independently editing another production copy in the Chinese repository during this rehearsal.

version_and_branch_policy.branches: One maintained default branch per repository; short-lived codex/* changes, not permanent branches per language/version. This experiment remains on codex/official-po.
version_and_branch_policy.versions: English source and Chinese locale can version independently; version names or matching branch names are not pairing guarantees.
version_and_branch_policy.candidate_rules: Dirty sources are previews, not candidates. Candidate artifacts are immutable and acceptance must bind to their exact bytes.

existing_workflow_not_migrated: Existing repositories remain on their current release/translation workflows. Their old runtime declaration or Tool SHA alone does not prove a fully locked 4.35 dependency set.
required_before_cutover: Verify official locale creation/import/selection and metadata/format labels with the server maintainers; never assume embedding PO in the template ZIP is enough.
Transfer the approved PO to exactly one authoritative location and replace the legacy translation generation path once, without dual-write synchronization.
Promote exact tooling/runtime and paired artifact guards into the existing workflow without adding parallel CI pipelines.
Choose new immutable publication versions, then bind acceptance to the final artifacts.
